---
title: "OSMnx · Download features (POIs)"
---

::: {.lead}
Buildings and amenities for Burjassot, snapped to the street network, plus the
geocoding and geometry helpers. Mirrors the
[Features panel](../../../panels/osmnx/features.qmd).
:::

Features download independently of any network, but snapping needs one present.

## 1. Download the features

**From Place** with `Burjassot, Valencia, Spain` and the tag to fetch (buildings
by default) brings the footprints in as a mesh. **From Point**, **From
Address**, **From BBox**, **From Polygon** and **From XML** cover the other
cases; **From Point** with a center and **Distance** gives a fixed radius.

![Downloading building footprints from a place.](../../../assets/guides/osmnx/07-features-place.png)

![The feature source buttons.](../../../assets/guides/osmnx/07-features-sources.png)

## 2. Snap POIs to the network

**Snap POIs** has three modes. **Attribute Only** records the nearest node
without moving anything. **Move to Node** relocates each POI onto its nearest
street node. **Add Connector** leaves the POI in place and draws a short edge to
the network.

![Snapping POIs to the nearest street nodes.](../../../assets/guides/osmnx/07-snap.png)

## 3. Geocoding and geometry helpers

**Geocode**, **Geocode to GDF**, **BBox from Point**, **BBox to Polygon**,
**Buffer**, **Interpolate** and **Sample Points**. **Geocode** resolves a place
name to coordinates without downloading anything.

![The geocoding and geometry helper buttons.](../../../assets/guides/osmnx/07-helpers.png)
